summary.name: Modernist Graphic Design. Supplemental design reference (provenance: supplemental), not claimed as a directly named style in the source collection.
summary.visualIdentity: Function-first graphic design built on simplified forms, shared alignment and a clear reading sequence. Hierarchy comes from size and placement within a limited palette. Source category: Graphic Design and Design Movements.
summary.suitableUses: Explicit good fits: UI and product storytelling, editorial and minimalist layouts, and motion posters with staged geometric compositions. Inferred from hybrid suggestions: process explainers, org structures, onboarding flows and infrastructure explainers where structural relationships need explaining.
summary.limitations: Animation must explain structural or informational change, and decoration must not compete with hierarchy. The palette stays limited to neutrals plus one blue accent, so warm accents from support palettes should be avoided. Stacking or pinning must not hide essential copy. Optional motion references are unsuitable when their required scene assets are absent.
summary.palette: Background policy is scene_dependent, and the status is style_compatible_suggestion, not an approved palette. Suggested tokens are background #FAF8F2 (illustrative only), foreground #202020 and accent_1 #235DA8, with no gradient. Choose the background from the scene; do not default to cream. Two-color checks give 15.342 for foreground on background and 6.174 for accent on background. Task-supplied exact colors override these tokens, and composited frames must be rechecked.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Explicit: movement explains structure through continuous, hierarchy-preserving motion with deliberate reading holds. Video uses deterministic composition time with one paused, seekable timeline. Optional references include pinned hero recomposition (motion-007), card stacking (008), chapter transition (012), swipe carousel (013), storytelling (015), phrase step-in (037) and punctuation zoom (038). Interactive delivery may use scroll or swipe, with completed static states under reduced motion.
summary.audio: Audio direction is unspecified for this style, and no mandatory audio layer is assigned. Options include restrained sound accents, ambience or silence, chosen by topic and kept clear of narration. Music is suitable only when its mood fits the content. The metadata includes no audio asset, and music sync requires measured audio analysis.
summary.assetRequirements: No asset files are listed, so asset availability is unspecified. Real fonts must load before rendering. Phrase and punctuation references need the actual phrase or mark present in the scene. A PhotoSwipe gallery needs accurate image dimensions, responsive sources and fallback links. Do not invent copy or a brand mark.
summary.combinations: Style-109 (animated line art) suits connectors: #202020 lines, blue only for the active path, and uniform stroke caps and joins. Style-108 (shallow isometric) suits system diagrams: neutral tints derived from existing tokens, flat labels and no perspective shrinkage. Avoid teal and terracotta, 3D lighting and rotated labels. Modernist design alone suits functional layouts.
summary.productionApproach: HyperFrames is the default pipeline and owns assembly, timing, validation and export. Remotion is a fallback only when HyperFrames is unavailable or a verified limitation blocks a required output. HTML/CSS and SVG are the style renderers, GSAP is the motion engine, and Motion is optional with explicit synchronization. chroma-js validates colors. Verify with check, snapshot and render, plus direct and backward seek tests.
